properties.description: Nine core tests on the cupping design: a result alone contests; the owner's ruling refutes, naming ruling, result and held model, and the hypothesis discharged into the missed prediction; withdrawn it contests again; unsigned it is no ruling; a signature naming someone else is refused; a what-if on the held idealization or the ruling names rulings_lost; supported given the held model; an undischarged supposition or an undocumented result reads as before; a design using neither reads as before.
